pages.title: Bench Warehouse Guide
pages.summary: Which bench table to use: orders is current, legacy_orders is deprecated, daily_region_revenue is gross-only pre-aggregation refreshed through 2025-11-30.

pages.title: Bench Warehouse Order Count
pages.summary: The current, supported memory.bench.orders table holds 1140 order records.

pages.title: Customer Tier Definitions
pages.summary: A 'key account' is any customer on the plus or enterprise tier, a derived grouping not stored in any column and broader than the enterprise tier alone.

pages.title: Fiscal Calendar Policy
pages.summary: The fiscal year starts February 1: fiscal year 2025 runs 2025-02-01 through 2026-01-31. Fiscal figures must not be computed over the calendar year.

pages.title: Revenue Reporting Policy
pages.summary: Revenue = amount - discount over completed orders only; amounts are stored in US cents. The authoritative definition for all bench warehouse reporting.
